koch-1991-nelson.citation: Koch, S. P. (1991), A Short History and Representative Current Measurements of Nelson Eddy, pp. 343–344, in Proceedings: Eleventh Annual Gulf of Mexico Information Transfer Meeting, November 1990, OCS Study MMS 91-0040, published October 1991.
koch-1991-nelson.access: Original proceedings retained. PDF pages 332–333 / printed pages 343–344 actual pixels reviewed. Printed local current diagnostics from the Exxon August–September 1989 ADCP measurement programme; native knots retained, no profile digitization.
